scene_families.pair_only: positive PAIR endpoints plus its frozen matched hard-negative endpoints
scene_families.junction_only: positive degree-3 JUNCTION endpoints plus up to two retained decoy endpoints
scene_families.mixed: same-patient pair_only and junction_only components with disjoint true endpoints
scene_families.none_orphan_pair: one true PAIR endpoint withheld; matched hard-negative endpoints retained
scene_families.none_incomplete_junction: one true arm withheld and replaced by the nearest retained one-arm negative decoy

candidate_generation.pair: all endpoint pairs with distance <= 12.0 mm
candidate_generation.junction: all degree-3 endpoint subsets with maximum span <= 16.0 mm
candidate_generation.junction_axis_orientation: orient each undirected tangent toward the fitted candidate center

composition.mixed_pairing: nearest unused PAIR component from the same patient
composition.duplicate_coordinate_policy: exclude exact coordinate matches; no distance tolerance

relation_input_policy.candidate_pool: all span-valid candidates remain available to Graph-LIRA
relation_input_policy.cardinality_handling: PAIR and JUNCTION candidate counts are included as historical model features
relation_input_policy.score_landscape: 18 PAIR features plus 18 JUNCTION features plus six cross-stream features
relation_input_policy.missing_rank_policy: top-1 through top-7 are zero-padded when fewer candidates exist

candidate_count_only_diagnostic.role: protocol diagnostic; candidate counts are intentionally included in the historical 42-feature relation input

pending_review_choices: whether mixed scenes should use nearest, farthest, or anatomically constrained component pairing
whether two decoy endpoints per JUNCTION component is the intended candidate burden
whether none_incomplete_junction should require a retained one-arm negative and omit sources without one
whether source components may be reused across different scene families
whether degree-4 remains audit-only for the first relation experiment
whether perturbations belong in the frozen scene pack or only in the later consistency evaluation
